content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle each serve specific markets but exclude vast regions. Stripe operates in only 46 of the 195 countries globally, leaving millions of creators without access. PayPal can suspend accounts for up to 180 days, locking funds without recourse. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH allows creators in restricted countries to own their entire stack, from payment processing to file delivery, without dependency on third-party platforms. This architecture empowers creators to bypass the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Most mainstream platforms restrict access based on geographic location, often due to regulatory or risk management concerns. Stripe requires compliance with local banking regulations, and PayPal has strict policies that often exclude users in high-risk regions. Conversely, COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to operate independently of these restrictions. Creators can utilize NOWPayments to securely process over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for conventional banking systems that may not operate in their countries. This creates a viable pathway for creators to monetize their digital products without geographical barriers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing on platforms like PayPal and Stripe often incurs fees that can accumulate quickly, especially for international transactions. PayPal’s fees can range up to 5%, while Stripe also charges various transaction fees depending on the country. The hidden costs of potential account freezes and fund holds can further complicate matters. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a competitive 0.5% fee per transaction with instant payment verification, ensuring that creators receive their funds promptly. This structural advantage allows creators to keep more of their revenue while ensuring that transactions are processed efficiently.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your online sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A major drawback of using traditional platforms is the lack of ownership over customer data and sales processes. When using Stripe or PayPal, creators are often subjected to their policies and restrictions, which can change at any time. With COREMERCH's architecture, creators maintain complete ownership of their digital storefront, including all customer data and sales history. The automated delivery of products through platforms like Cloudflare R2 ensures that buyers receive their purchases instantly, creating a seamless experience without reliance on third-party systems. This level of control is essential for creators looking to build sustainable businesses.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in regions restricted by payment platforms, adopting a sovereign commerce infrastructure is not just an option; it’s a necessity. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust solution, combining Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a comprehensive digital storefront. It is designed to be deployed in 48 hours, allowing creators to start selling quickly without the bureaucratic hurdles of traditional platforms. This stack is ideal for those looking to establish a resilient online presence, ensuring that they are not left vulnerable to external restrictions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
